blocks.text: Leave policies are defined by the HR department and may change yearly.
Payroll integration is described in a separate document.

Payroll integration is described in a separate document. The system shall allow an employee to submit an annual leave request with start and end dates. For example, The request shows the number of working days requested.

Leave policies are defined by the HR department and may change yearly. The system shall prevent a leave request that exceeds the remaining balance. For example, Requesting 6 days with a balance of 5 shows an error.
Payroll integration is described in a separate document. The system shall notify the direct manager when a request is submitted. For example, The manager receives an in-app notification and an email.

Leave policies are defined by the HR department and may change yearly. The manager must approve or reject a request within 3 working days. For example, After 3 working days the request escalates to HR.

Payroll integration is described in a separate document. The system shall exclude public holidays from the calculated leave days. For example, A request spanning a public holiday counts one day fewer.
